text: なにか　したくなったら　また　こえを　かけてくれよ

structure.en: if you come to want to do

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら after a verb or adjective means 'if' or 'when'. したくなったら = 'if you come to want to do it'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: てくれる says someone does something for you, and a casual request when told to someone. かけてくれよ = 'call out to me, will you'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい after a verb means 'want to'; くなる means 'come to be'. したくなる = 'come to want to do'.
